changelog: Added mobile/cellular carrier filtering for Impossible Travel — select which ISPs to ignore in Settings to suppress false positives caused by carrier IP reassignment across cell towers
Added license expiration enforcement with tiered grace periods — warning banners at 15, 7, and 1 day before expiration; Live Map disabled at expiration; full monitoring pause after grace period ends
License state now refreshes automatically via the sync trigger, not only when the sheet is opened
Fixed Impossible Travel false positives caused by AT&T, T-Mobile, Verizon, and other carrier-grade-NAT IP pools being misidentified as cross-country travel
